scope: anonymous Korean Olive Young Best Store public ranking reads; no affiliate/Curator pages and no account session

source.transport: createOliveyoungHttpFetch; cookie-free curl_cffi Chrome-compatible HTTP session

categoryNavigation.semantics: The clicked category id becomes fltDispCatNo. The current hidden dispCatNo is carried through unchanged. The returned hidden form must echo the requested fltDispCatNo.

responseContract.rankBinding: The numeric rank marker and the unique same-li product detail link goodsNo must agree in one rendered card; only explicit ranks 1 through 100 are accepted.
responseContract.optionRangeHint: A visible ~ suffix is preserved on both displayed price values; it indicates a product-level range/starting-price cue, not a selected option price.
responseContract.availability: Only an explicit visible 품절 marker sets unavailable. Missing status remains unknown.
responseContract.freshness: The source has no captured as-of timestamp; checkedAt is retrieval time and sourceAsOf remains null.

limitations: This capability reads the server-rendered Best Store document; it is not an XHR endpoint.
The UI exposes page-level dispCatNo and category fltDispCatNo separately; only values observed in the current form are sent.

All 21 current category controls were observed, but only the skincare filter has a successful live request/readback. A bounded serial verification sweep encountered HTTP 429 before its first category-specific request and stopped without retrying.
A product-level range cue is not an option-specific price.
Availability is not inferred from sale, promotion or missing flags.
